title: Design System: INALA Centro de Psicoterapia

display.purpose: Home h1 and display-size step numerals.

title.purpose: The h1 of every page except home.

heading.purpose: Section h2s, closing call to action, large quotes.

subheading.purpose: Service names, topic rows, quotes, closing notes, subtitles under headings.

lead.purpose: Intro paragraphs; at 600 for FAQ questions and short list titles.

label.purpose: Breadcrumbs, captions, durations and prices, footer column headings. Sentence case.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Desktop services dropdown and open mobile menu panel only.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entrances, reveals, presses, dropdown and FAQ.

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.value: rise 700ms ease-out, translateY(14px) to none, 80ms stagger per child

motion.name: hero-settle
motion.value: settle 900ms ease-out 120ms, translateY(18px) scale(0.985) to none

motion.name: figure-reveal
motion.purpose: One-shot reveal of figures below the fold (src/scripts/reveal.ts).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Only motion kept under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (hero).

narrative.overview:
The site is the arrangement a visitor already expects from a psychology practice: who she is, what she treats, how it works, what it costs, how to ask. Its distinction is finish, not novelty; the quality bar is premium wellness products (Headspace, Calm) for polish, never for their look. Cool paper and pure white grounds carry near-black green ink; the logo's seafoam is the recognisable brand note; deep teal marks every action; one deep cypress field closes every page.

Content is separated by hairline rules and generous whitespace, not by cards. Photographs sit in one consistent rounded frame. Headlines are set in Gambetta at regular weight, text and interface in Synonym. Motion is one calm, authored hero entrance per page and quiet one-shot reveals of figures below the fold, transform and opacity only, reduced to short fades when the visitor asks for less motion.

The world rejects, by the owner's choice: glassmorphism, decorative gradients, blurred blobs, heavy shadows, and walls of rounded icon-tile cards (the incumbent mint wash it replaces).
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper, white and mist grounds; one cypress field that closes each page.
Gambetta headlines at weight 400; Synonym for everything else.
Hairline rules and whitespace instead of cards.
Pill buttons in deep teal for every action.
One rounded photo frame for all imagery.
Numerals for steps the reader follows in order.
One authored hero entrance; everything else is still.

rules.name: The Seafoam Is Not Text Rule
rules.body: Seafoam is never text on paper, white or mist; it is a fill, a hairline or an accent. On the cypress field it may be text (headings, subtitles, the focus ring).

rules.name: The One Action Colour Rule
rules.body: Every clickable action on a light ground is teal. Nothing else is teal-filled.

rules.name: The Closing Field Rule
rules.body: Cypress appears once per page, at the end: the final call to action, then (on service pages) the other services, then the footer, as one continuous dark field.

rules.name: The Subtitle, Not Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: A short label kept from the content renders as a Gambetta subtitle under its heading (muted ink on light grounds, seafoam on cypress), never as a small label above it. A label the heading already contains renders as a small body caption in soft ink. A label typed in capitals in the content stays in capitals, set one size smaller (lead instead of subheading).

rules.name: The Regular Weight Rule
rules.body: Gambetta headings stay at weight 400. Hierarchy comes from size, not weight.

rules.name: The Rules Not Boxes Rule
rules.body: Groups of content are separated by a 1px hairline and whitespace. A topic, service or step is never a filled or shadowed card.

rules.name: The Only Floats Float Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the element sits above the page. Static content never carries one.

rules.name: The One Frame Rule
rules.body: Every photograph and illustration sits in the same frame: 20px radius, clipped, with a mist ground while loading, in one of five fixed ratios (4:5 portrait, 3:4 tall, 4:3 landscape, 16:10 wide, square). Imagery is never borderless, tilted or masked into other shapes. Only María's small portrait on Contacto is a circle.

dos: **Do** use teal (#24695b) for every action on light grounds and teal-strong for its hover.
**Do** separate content with 1px hairlines and whitespace, alternating paper, white and mist sections.
**Do** set short content labels as Gambetta subtitles under their heading; keep labels typed in capitals in capitals, one size smaller.
**Do** close every page on the cypress field: final call to action, other services where relevant, footer.
**Do** put every image in the one frame (20px radius) at one of the five ratios.
**Do** number only sequences the reader follows in order, in teal Gambetta numerals.
**Do** keep motion to transform and opacity, and give every animation a reduced-motion fallback.
**Do** keep all copy the site's original text; mark any gap as `[PENDIENTE: ...]`.
donts: **Don't** set seafoam (#7cc6c4) as text on paper, white or mist.
**Don't** put a small label or kicker above a heading.
**Don't** build grids of rounded icon-tile cards, or give static content a shadow.
**Don't** use glassmorphism, decorative gradients, blurred blobs or heavy shadows.
**Don't** italicise headings for emphasis; colour the run teal instead.
**Don't** add a second icon family, hand-drawn icon paths or Tailwind default colours.
**Don't** add motion beyond the hero entrance and figure reveals, or animate layout properties.
